[P2] Keep blocked target waiters from consuming active-work permits

With `scenarioConcurrency=2`, an exclusive case and a second case waiting on its target consume both permits, preventing a third case on an idle profile from progressing. The added independent-profile progress test fails when the busy profile finishes preparation first: its active case waits for progress that the semaphore prevents. Coordinate permit allocation with eligible lease admission, while preserving admitted owners' ability to resume, and make the regression control preparation order explicitly.
